title: Joint limit of total life and relative age
exact_target: If the rescaled interval length and relative age each have limits, must their joint limit exist and be independent?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9900003 (AMR-098-0003). CC BY 4.0.
